title: Shipping JPEG XL in Chrome
summary: Chrome officially shipped JPEG XL support, a next-generation image format offering superior compression (60% smaller than JPEG), lossless quality, transparency, and animation capabilities. This marks a significant advancement in web image optimization standards.
problem_solved: Provides a modern image format that solves the trade-off between file size and quality while offering features like transparency and animation that existing formats lack.
why_valuable: JPEG XL enables significantly faster web page loads and reduced bandwidth costs without compromising image quality, benefiting both users and website operators.
